content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_Period
content_blocks.text: Tenant is hereby given notice that they are in violation of the lease agreement and must vacate the premises within 14 days.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Reason_for_Eviction
content_blocks.text: The reason for eviction is non-payment of rent, as detailed in the attached statement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant does not vacate the premises, legal action will be taken against them.
